identity: A very short (89 tokens) amateur Arabic didactic composition on التسامح (tolerance/forgiveness) — the shape of a school essay or a moral-exhortation paragraph. One unbroken block: zero <NL> tokens in the whole document, so the only free boundary is the final token @88. Register markers: tiny vocabulary recycled throughout (التسامح x3, المحبة x3, أكثر تعاطفا verbatim twice, في المجتمع verbatim twice), no subordination deeper than one level, no proper nouns, no Latin script, no digits, no quotation, no dialogue. Structure is thesis (التسامح شيء مهم) -> reasons -> restatement with لذلك -> gnomic definitions (والمسامح هو الشخص الكريم) -> closing injunction to the reader (ويجب أن تسامح وتعلم أطفالك). Note the mid-text person shift from 1pl (نتعلم، نصبح، نعزز) to 2sg (تتعلم، تقدر، تسامح، أطفالك) — a hortatory essay talking to its reader, not analytic prose. By LAW 6 this is NOT my §B/§L encyclopedic register (12-20 tok); its clause inventory averages ~6 tokens, putting it between §J textbook prose and §B expository. I set the target sentence length at 6-10 tokens.
law: The sentence unit here is ONE PREDICATION ABOUT THE TOPIC. LAW 0 governs: I under-cut 5:1, so at a coin-flip site I cut. Applied concretely: (1) LAW 1 — و followed by a clause carrying a NEW ARGUMENT (new subject NP or new topic) is a new sentence: ويجب @12, ونشره @57, والمسامح @62, وأن تتعلم @66, ويجب @82 all open sentences. (2) LAW 1's exception holds with equal force — و joining bare VPs that share a subject and add only an object rides along: ينمي ويثقف، ويجعله، وتعلم أطفالك، and every phrasal و (ثقافة ومحبة، المحبة والمودة، أكثر قوة ومحبوبا، المساجد والمدارس والمحاضرات) are welded. The test is a new argument, never the letter و. (3) LAW 4 is the strongest brake in this document and it is what makes two segments long: a subordinate clause TRAILING its main clause belongs to it, so no cut before لأنه @27 and none before لكي @75; the cut goes after the adjunct. (4) Asyndetic fresh predication with a resumptive pronoun (منه @5, إنه @49) is a sentence start — the source put ink there. (5) Conclusive/emphatic openers لذلك and إنه start sentences. Result: 11 segments, ~8.1 tokens each, which matches the register I measured off the opening.
reasoning: @4 الحياة (hi). Thesis التسامح شيء مهم في الحياة is a complete nominal sentence; منه نتعلم is asyndetic with a FRONTED resumptive PP and its own predicate. Whether the source had a full stop or a comma, both became ‖ under LAW 0's corollary. This is the most canonical period site in the text. || @11 تعاطفا (hi). ويجب أن نعزز — و + new modal predicate + a whole new deontic move (from what we learn to what we must do). LAW 1 at full strength, the clearest و-boundary here. || @18 المجتمع (med). THE FIRST HARD SITE. في المجتمع في المساجد is two adjacent PPs with no connective, the second specifying the first — the apposition shape of LAW 3 (شيئا … شيئا) and the comma-set list of B5. Reading the ink, a writer sets an appositive list off with a comma or a colon: في المجتمع، في المساجد والمدارس والمحاضرات. There is a second reason to believe a mark fell here: والحرص @23 coordinates back to the OBJECT ثقافة التسامح (we must promote the culture of tolerance … and keenness to read the Qur'an), which makes في المساجد والمدارس والمحاضرات an inserted parenthetical — and B5 says a comma-set parenthetical yields boundaries, not zero. I put this at ~55% and LAW 0 says cut at 50. Cutting also fixes an otherwise 31-token run, far past this register's ceiling. I do NOT cut @22 before والحرص: that is a phrase-level و joining two nouns, LAW 1's exception. || @26 القرءان — NO CUT. لأنه is a trailing causal adjunct on نعزز/الحرص. LAW 4 names لأن explicitly; my batch-1 error at doc_56781db1019f @634 was exactly this shape (reading a trailing adjunct as fronting the next clause). The cut goes AFTER the adjunct, and it does — at @42. || @34 تعاطفا (med). THE SECOND HARD SITE, and the one I argued longest. Two forces collide. Against cutting: يساعد … ويقلل … وينشر is one subject (القرءان) running three VPs, each adding only an object — textbook VP-chain exemption, and my own gold evidence (فجلس وأكل خبزا وشرب ماء ‖ is ONE segment; a three-verb chain rides). For cutting: leaving it whole makes 19-42 a 24-token segment, and Arabic sets off heavy coordinate predicates with commas. I broke the tie on WEIGHT, not on count: every gold VP-chain member I have on record is 1-3 tokens (وزرعها، وشرب ماء، وحفر حفرة), whereas يساعد على بناء ثقافة ومحبة أكثر تعاطفا is 8 tokens — heavy enough to have taken its own mark. LAW 5 then fixes the SITE: annotators cut at the FIRST available و in a run, not the second, so the boundary is before ويقلل @35, not before وينشر @38. || @37 المشاكل — NO CUT, deliberately, and this is the place I am most likely to be wrong. Symmetry argues ويقلل and وينشر are structurally identical and should share a fate. I overrode symmetry because after cutting @34 the remainder ويقلل من المشاكل وينشر المحبة والمودة في المجتمع is 8 tokens — the same length as the إنه-run below that I am welding, so the two parallel chains in this document get consistent treatment. I score @37 at ~40%, under the coin flip, so LAW 0 does not reach it. Logged as a T3-family test: if gold cuts here, my weight-based override of the VP-chain rule is too weak and the rule is really comma-driven. || @42 المجتمع (hi). لذلك is a conclusive connector restating the thesis; nothing welds across it. || @48 البشر (hi). إنه + emphatic assertion, asyndetic, fresh predicate — same shape as منه @5. || @50, @52 — NO CUT. ينمي ويثقف share the single object الإنسان (pure phrase-level و), and ويجعله is V + clitic object with the same subject — this is وزرعها exactly, which gold rode along. || @56 ومحبوبا (hi). ونشره introduces a NEW SUBJECT NP (نشره, the maṣdar 'its spreading') with its own predicate يساعد. LAW 1 / C4, new topic NP. Note the و I am cutting AT is the end of أكثر قوة ومحبوبا — that inner و is phrasal and welded; the boundary falls after it. || @61 الوعي (hi). والمسامح هو الشخص الكريم — و + new topic NP + nominal predicate. This is C4 verbatim and the text turns here from effects to definitions. || @65 الكريم (hi). وأن تتعلم الكرم هذا يكون … — و + a new fronted subject clause with its own resumptive هذا and its own predicate يكون. New topic, new predication. || @68 الكرم — NO CUT, considered and rejected. هذا resumes the fronted أن-clause, and a left-dislocation comma is plausible (compare §H3, where a bare dislocated topic was its own segment). But §H3's case was a one-word dialogue turn under a <NL>; here the resumption is tight and this register writes it as one flow. ~35-40%, below the LAW 0 threshold. || @74 الحياة — NO CUT. لكي تقدر أن تعيش is a trailing purpose clause on يكون شيئا جميلا. Same LAW 4 family as لأن/حتى/بعد أن. The two 16-token segments in my answer (19-34 and 66-81) are long for exactly one principled reason: both end in a LAW-4-protected trailing subordinator, so their length is a consequence of the law, not of timidity. || @81 مميزة (hi). ويجب أن تسامح — و + new modal predicate, and the text's final pivot into 2sg direct injunction. Structurally identical to @11, which is my strongest independent check on it. || @84 تسامح — NO CUT. تسامح وتعلم are two subjunctives under one أن sharing the subject; phrase-level coordination. || @88 والمحبة (hi). Final token, mandatory. || DENSITY CHECK: 11 segments over 89 tokens = 8.1 tokens/segment, inside the 6-10 window I set from the opening, and well clear of the 25+ that produced my batch-1 catastrophe.
